name: Command Message
summary: Adversaries may block a command message from reaching its intended target to prevent command execution. In OT networks, command messages are sent to provide instructions to control system devices. A blocked command message can inhibit response functions from correcting a disruption or unsafe condition.

analytics.name: Analytic 1916
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies the absence of expected command-message delivery confirmation -- a Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA)-issued command that does not produce the expected corresponding state-change response within the normal response latency window, while the device remains reachable for other traffic. Documented in the 2015 Ukraine attack, where Sandworm used malicious firmware to render serial-to-Ethernet converters inoperable. analytics.name: Analytic 2118
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies iptables/nftables rule additions on Industrial Control System (ICS) Linux gateways that filter ICS command messages based on content, while allowing other traffic to pass. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.
